title: Inlock introduces Savings Account
description: Inlock launched a custodial crypto Savings Account with weekly interest payments.
notes: The product launch date is documented by Inlock's first-party announcement and FAQ.

title: Inlock activates emergency shutdown
description: Inlock suspended deposits, withdrawals, new loans, onboarding and interest after a failed liquidation process made part of customer assets unavailable.
notes: Inlock described the unavailable portion as small but isolated all customer-asset activity while pursuing recovery.

title: Recovery and Restructuring Plan begins
description: Inlock issued a Recovery and Restructuring Plan that introduced alternative recovery paths including migration, exit payouts and scheduled releases.
notes: The plan date is stated in Inlock's detailed April 2023 recovery-program guide.

title: Scheduled-release payments begin
description: Inlock began monthly pro-rata USDC payments under the Scheduled Release program after offering migration and discounted exit-payout alternatives.
notes: Recovery treatment differed by chosen program and was not one uniform repayment path.

title: Scheduled-release cohort exceeds fixed incident-value benchmark
description: Inlock reported that scheduled-release customers had received more than 103.4% of the fixed U.S.-dollar value of affected assets recorded at the November 2022 incident date.
notes: The metric was cohort-specific and value-based; individual ratios and in-kind asset outcomes varied.

title: Final Settlement program closes
description: Inlock completed its Final Settlement program after partial legal compensation enabled a settlement offer, while scheduled releases continued for customers who did not accept the offer.
notes: More than 75% of outstanding asset value was settled for accepting customers, but residual scheduled-release claims remained.

title: Inlock ends active services
description: Inlock completed the wind-down of all active financial and token-related services and moved the platform to temporary read-only access before permanent decommissioning.
notes: Read-only account access continued until 30 September 2026 and customer support until 31 December 2026.

title: Stablehouse opens early access
description: Stablehouse opened early access to a digital-asset platform offering fixed interest on supported crypto assets.
notes: Stablehouse was incubated within the wider XBTO group before later acquisition.

title: Stablehouse revises yield-rate structure
description: Stablehouse announced new rates and deposit tiers for stablecoin and other digital-asset yield products.
notes: The announcement documented the continuing retail and professional yield model before the later institutional transition.

title: XBTO announces Stablehouse acquisition
description: XBTO announced a strategic acquisition of Stablehouse, subject to Bermuda Monetary Authority approval, to expand institutional custody and trading services.
notes: The announcement did not provide the eventual legal completion date.

title: Stablehouse documented as wholly owned XBTO subsidiary
description: Updated custody terms identified Stablehouse as a wholly owned subsidiary of XBTO Global, providing the first dated post-announcement evidence that the acquisition had completed.
notes: The date is the custody-terms update date, not a claimed exact legal closing date. XBTO's corporate timeline confirms full acquisition during 2023.

title: XBTO launches ProTrading powered by Stablehouse
description: XBTO and Stablehouse launched an institutional trading product combining execution with custody infrastructure, demonstrating the post-acquisition product transition.
notes: The transition did not represent a platform failure or customer-repayment event.
